note: Satisfied as built with its limit on the record (vc, 2026-09-12). Every write the API takes names its acting node and touches only that node's board, or the inbox it sends into. error_remedies.rs provokes the refusal of a write whose acting node is not registered, by name with the roster. A write that names no acting node at all is refused before it reaches the facade, by the renderer's acting_node, rather than guessed. THE LIMIT: the acting node's identity is the caller's claim through --node; structural enforcement needs it sourced from somewhere the caller does not choose, which is with hv beside INTENT_NODE.
